purpose: Teach: 歳月/安打/口実/地検/回生/町並み/孔/陵

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、長い歳月をかけて築いたブランドを大事にしろ
lines.en: I want this company to protect the brand we've built over decades.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Direct eye contact. Deliberate pace on each phrase. The weight of expectation without aggression.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。営業の安打、つまり成約率を上げます
lines.en: Yes. We'll increase our sales close rate.
lines.style: Clipped, professional acknowledgment. Quick lean forward on 'close rate.' Absorbing the instruction without hesitation. Steady, reliable.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、納期遅れの口実を許すな
lines.en: And don't accept excuses about missed deadlines.
lines.style: Firm, unwavering. Sharp consonants on 'don't' and 'deadlines.' No room for negotiation in the voice. Eyes narrowing slightly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地検からの照会には法務部が対応します
lines.en: Understood. The legal team will handle any regulatory inquiries.
lines.style: Confident, assured response. Nods subtly while speaking. Takes ownership of the statement. Controlled, professional delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、失敗した社員の回生機会を設けろ
lines.en: Create opportunities for staff who have made mistakes to recover.
lines.style: Quieter, more considered than the previous directives. Slight pause before 'recover.' The conviction underneath is stronger, not louder. Almost vulnerable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古い町並みに合うレトロ店舗を出店します
lines.en: Yes. We're opening retro-style locations that fit the character of older neighborhoods.
lines.style: Energized, forward-looking. Picks up pace. Shows understanding of the vision. Concrete, actionable. A hint of enthusiasm breaking through the formality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、製品の毛穴つまり孔の品質を点検しろ
lines.en: We'll inspect product quality carefully—especially the details others might overlook.
lines.style: Precise, methodical. Emphasis on 'carefully.' Slight slow-down on 'overlook.' Shows he understands the standard being set. Respectful of the demand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。古墳陵墓近くの工事は慎重におこないます
lines.en: Understood. Any construction near historical sites will be handled with extreme care.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, measured close. Slight bow in the voice—respect and closure. Longer pause at the end, showing complete absorption of the instruction.
